meta.name: exa-search
meta.description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索网页并提取链接内容,快速获取技术资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在研究或开发中快速获取网页和论文内容。
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and extract page content to get technical info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly gather web pages and papers for work or study.

howto.what: 装上本技能后，Claude能通过Exa执行两类联网任务：网络搜索（可限定学术论文/领域）和URL内容提取（支持批量网页、文章、学术PDF）。学术文献引用附作者和年份。
howto.when: 当用户要求搜索、查找、获取/提取网页内容等联网任务时触发；科学或技术类查询会自动启用学术过滤。

say.text: 帮我搜索关于CRISPR的最新研究论文。
say.note: 调用搜索并偏向“研究论文”类别。

say.text: 提取这个网址的内容并做摘要：arxiv.org/abs/2401.12345
say.note: 调用提取，获取该网页正文并总结。

say.text: 查一下大语言模型安全方面近两年的权威文献。
say.note: 触发研究论文类别与学术域过滤。

howto.what_en: Claude uses Exa for web search (semantic lookups, current info, research-paper category) and URL extraction (batch fetch of pages, articles, academic PDFs). Academic citations include author and year when available.
howto.when_en: Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article. Scientific/technical queries automatically bias toward academic sources via category=research paper.

say_en.text: Search for the latest research papers on CRISPR.
say_en.note: Uses web search with research-paper category.

say_en.text: Extract and summarize the content at arxiv.org/abs/2401.12345.
say_en.note: Calls URL extraction to fetch and summarize the page.

say_en.text: Find recent authoritative papers on large language model safety.
say_en.note: Applies academic filtering and scholarly source priority.
